parsed.why: No criminalisation, no documented targeting of trans visitors, constitutional equality guarantee. Dated societal stigma, thin trans-specific record and unresolved document/screening questions hold it below acceptance-with-protections tier.

Enforced cross-dressing offence with conviction, no document alignment possible, religious code with stoning/whipping under revocable moratorium, police intimidation, no independent rights bodies. Trans-specific state criminal exposure dominates.

Court decriminalisation, police-protected Pride, PM support, friendly polls; no traveller-facing restriction documented. Death threats, election hate speech, one dated trans harassment and no gender-identity cover cap it below low-risk.

Government cancelled LGBTQ event, rejected anti-violence recommendations, documented anti-trans violence and concealment norm, unequal age of consent. Tier-3 societal hostility with thin recourse outweighs data-protection laws.

Never criminalised, no documented targeting, traditional trans visibility, diplomatic backing. Offset by state tolerance only absent activism, blocked LGBTI pages, social-media repression and thin trans-specific record.
